decisions.reason: As a support service very close to the firm’s core offer, premium customer support likely clears or nearly clears aspiration levels through strong complementarities with hosting and retention, so a medium-sized growing firm with some slack would keep it.

The software version management tool builds directly on the firm’s platform and automation capabilities, and its dedicated presentation suggests enough acceptance relative to aspirations to justify continued support as part of the hosting ecosystem.

The data-processing-contract tool is more distant from the core hosting business and, with only limited observed persistence, is the product most likely to fall short of aspirations and have its resources reallocated to closer, higher-synergy activities.
Scalable hosting for agencies is tightly aligned with the firm’s main customer group and strategic direction, so in a growing market management would keep investing in it rather than withdraw.
